title: Find the Child Who Has the Ball After K Seconds
summary: Given positive integers n and k, there are n children in a queue numbered 0 to n-1.
statement: Given positive integers n and k, there are n children in a queue numbered 0 to n-1. Child 0 starts with a ball and passes it right. After k seconds, the ball's final holder is determined. If the ball reaches an end, the direction reverses. Return the child number with the ball.
constraints: Children are indexed zero through n-1 in a line and child zero starts with the ball.
The ball moves one child per second and reverses direction at each endpoint.
Return the holder after k seconds.
hints: The holder sequence repeats after traveling from zero to n-1 and back.
Reduce k by that period; positions before n move right, and later positions reflect back as period-step.
Modulo locates the same phase in the repeated deterministic motion.
editorial: Modulo locates the same phase in the repeated deterministic motion.

tests.explanation: The holders are 1,2,1,0,1, so child one has the ball.
The ball reaches child four then returns to child two.
